annotations.title: Find a youth soccer tournament (Tournament Scout)

description: Search the Pitch Network tournament registry by name, host club, city or date range. Returns dates, venue, platform and whether Scout can read its brackets. Use the id with pitch/scout-tournament. Covers every Pitch Network region.

from.description: Earliest date, YYYY-MM-DD. Default today when no query is given.

query.description: Words from the tournament name, host club or city, such as "Cardiff" or "Surf Cup".

region.description: scp SoCal, ncp NorCal, pnw Pacific Northwest, mw Mountain West, sw Southwest, or all.

name: pitch-find-tournament
title: Find a youth soccer tournament (Tournament Scout)
